# Alec

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Alec is described as having a good-tempered demeanor. Physically, he is noted for his lovely, black, curly hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)_

## Personality

Alec is a good-tempered individual with curly black hair. He possesses a strong understanding of how to attend to the lighthouse light, demonstrating a level of skill equal to that of the lighthouse keeper.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)_

## Traits

## Goals

## History

Alec is a local resident who arrived at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) to deliver the tragic news that John Douglas's mother was dying. His announcement brought about the end of the matriarch's life shortly thereafter. Alec's report inadvertently paved the way for [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) to finally propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md) following the funeral, as the secret oath holding John back was dissolved upon his mother's passing.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P41](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0041), [v3 ch.Lady P49](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0049), [v3 ch.Lady P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050), [v3 ch.Lady P51](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0051), [v3 ch.Lady P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 ch.Lady P55](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0055), +234 more_

## Relationships

### [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alec and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) are rivals competing for the affections of [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) back in her hometown. During Anne's visit to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), Alec actively courts [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) alongside [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), creating an ongoing dynamic where both men vie for the same woman's favor.

- Rival of — rival suitors for Phil Gordon  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Speaks P5](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0005)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

Alec acts as one of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's dedicated suitors back at her home in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). He actively courts her alongside rival suitors, contributing to Phil's hesitation and indecision regarding her romantic life.

- Romantically involved with — suitor  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), +1 more</sub>

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--uncle-jim.md)

Alec is the nephew of [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md). Their familial relationship forms part of Alec's broader family network in the area.

- Relative of — nephew (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)</sub>
